releases.title: Noclip & ESP fixes
changes: Fixed noclip - now properly disables collision on all body parts
Fixed murderer ESP - now always shows murderers regardless of weapon state
Improved role detection with persistent caching for murderers/sheriffs
Enhanced collision disabling with double-check for reliability

releases.title: 3D chams
changes: Real D3D11 3D chams: translucent fill with bright edges and optional glow
Chams fill alpha slider, team check and accessories toggle, with automatic 2D fallback
Per-Monitor V2 DPI awareness so the overlay is sharp and correctly sized on laptops and scaled displays
Overlay now follows the Roblox window when it moves, resizes or changes monitor
Graphics adapter fallback for Intel, AMD and NVIDIA plus automatic device-lost recovery
Configs are saved to AppData (works on locked-down machines)
Cooler, steadier frame pacing (lower CPU/GPU load)
Attach fix: waits for the Roblox DataModel before starting and shows clear error messages

releases.title: Baseline build
changes: Public Oxide.exe build published before release tracking was added
